thesis: This episode argues that traditional value investing metrics may be dead, suggesting that market reactions to new service announcements often cause stocks to drop regardless of the underlying business strength. The discussion highlights the competitive threats posed by large tech giants like Amazon and Meta entering new spaces, while noting the unique advantages of subscription models and high customer surplus found in companies like Costco.
